eventDetail.scope: Artificial Intelligence x Science, Engineering, and Technology (AIxSET) is an international forum for academia and industries to exchange visions and ideas in the state of the art and practice, as well as to identify the emerging topics and define the synergy between AI, science, engineering and technology in general.  ​TOPICS OF INTEREST​​ include:  Areas of science and engineering that may be assisted by AI, such as:​ - Biological Sciences - Chemistry - Earth, Planetary, and Space Sciences - Mathematics - Statistics - Physical Sciences - Social Sciences - Electrical Engineering - Mechanical Engineering - Civil Engineering  AI Technologies that may be advanced by scientific and engineering applications, such as: - Generative AI - Transformer based technology - Agent technology - Semantic computing - Decision making - Machine learning - Security - Knowledge and data engineering - Platform and scalability
